THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Busy-Day Steak Taco Plates

One 22 oz Soules Kitchen family pack. Two plate builds. Adult plate = 420 cal / 40g protein — 3 Carb Counter tortillas, salsa roja, half serving Khloud chips. Kid plate = 2 regular street-taco tortillas, Wholly Guacamole, regular chips. Split at portion + tortilla + sauce + chip. 10 min end-to-end.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~420 cal | ~40g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: STOVETOP OVER MICROWAVE. Every time. Add 1/4 cup bone broth (or water), cover, medium-high 3-4 min. This is the entire cook step.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 1 family pack / 22 oz Soules Kitchen Street Taco Steak with Salsa Roja

ADULT TORTILLAS

  • 6 La Banderita Carb Counter Street Taco tortillas (3 per adult)

ADULT CHIPS

  • 1 serving Khloud Nacho Protein Chips (1/2 serving per adult)

LIQUID FOR REHEAT

  • 1/4 cup chicken bone broth (or water)

ADULT SAUCE

  • Included Soules Kitchen salsa roja packets (divide across 2 adult plates)

Option 1

  • 4 Mission regular Street Taco flour tortillas (2 per kid)
  • 2 Wholly Guacamole minis (1 per kid)
  • 1 serving regular tortilla chips (1/2 serving per kid)

Allergens: gluten, dairy.

AT THE PLATE — same skillet steak, same reheat, same broth. Adult vs kid forks on portion (1 1/3 vs 2/3 servings) + tortilla (Carb Counter vs regular Mission) + sauce (salsa roja vs Wholly guac) + chip (Khloud protein vs regular). Four axes of split for a 10-min dinner is a LOT — that's why the video-edit calls this out.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.SKILLET + STEAK. Nonstick skillet on medium-high. Add the full 22 oz Soules Kitchen steak (right from the package, no drain). Reserve the salsa roja packets.
  2. 2.BROTH. Pour in 1/4 cup chicken bone broth (or water). Cover the skillet.
  3. 3.HEAT. Medium-high, covered, 3-4 min. Stir once mid-way. Steak is FULLY COOKED — you're only reheating.
  4. 4.TORTILLAS WARM. While the steak heats, warm 6 La Banderita Carb Counter (adult) + 4 Mission regular street-taco (kid) tortillas. Wrap both stacks in a clean towel or tortilla warmer.

Adult — 3 Carb-Counter Tacos + Salsa Roja + Khloud Chips

  1. 5.ADULT SAUCE. Empty the included salsa roja packets into a small ramekin per adult plate.
  2. 6.ADULT STEAK. 1 1/3 servings steak (~7 oz) on the plate. Tortillas warm + folded next to it.
  3. 7.ADULT CHIPS. 1/2 serving Khloud Nacho Protein Chips beside the steak. Assemble tacos at the table.

Kid — 2 Regular Tacos + Wholly Guac + Regular Chips · Option 1

  1. 5.KID STEAK. 2/3 serving steak (~3.5 oz) in one compartment of the tray.
  2. 6.KID GUAC. 1 Wholly Guacamole mini cup in another compartment. Peel the seal, set it in the tray.
  3. 7.KID TORTILLAS + CHIPS. 2 warm Mission street-taco tortillas folded next to the steak + 1/2 serving regular chips in the last compartment.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — 3 Carb-Counter Tacos + Salsa Roja + Khloud Chips: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — 2 Regular Tacos + Wholly Guac + Regular Chips: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • FAMILY PACK USES 1/4 CUP, NOT PACKAGE-SUGGESTED SMALLER AMOUNT. The 22 oz pack has more surface area — needs a bit more liquid than the label's default.
  • TORTILLAS WARM SEPARATELY. Adult Carb Counter + kid Mission both go into a clean towel or tortilla warmer while the steak heats. Cold tortilla = split-plate failed.

If something fails

Steak came out rubbery: Microwaved instead of stovetop. Or heated too long. Aim for 3-4 min covered on medium-high — steak is ALREADY cooked, you're just reheating.

Not enough broth left in the pan / dried out: Started with too little liquid. Family pack (22 oz) needs 1/4 cup broth, not less. Or covered temperature was too high — drop to medium if it's evaporating fast.

Kid won't touch the guacamole: Deconstructed plate lets them skip it. Warm tortilla + steak cubes + chips is a totally acceptable dinner. Don't force the guac.

Adult tortillas taste 'diet-y': Carb Counter tortillas have a slightly different chew than regular. Warm them well (30 sec in the tortilla warmer) — cold Carb Counter reads worse than warm. If a specific adult rejects them, sub Mission Carb Balance small size for a closer-to-regular texture.

No Soules Kitchen at your store: Any refrigerated fully-cooked carne asada works — Del Real Foods, Trader Joe's, Costco Mexican-style. Frozen carne asada works but add thawing time. The recipe is the pattern, not the brand.

Storage and reheating

Store: This is an emergency-inventory dinner, not a batch-cook. Keep the Soules Kitchen family pack refrigerated with the use-by date visible. Keep Carb Counter + Mission tortillas on the shelf. Keep Khloud + regular chips in the pantry. Wholly minis in the fridge (long shelf life).

Reheat: Leftover steak: covered skillet with a splash of broth on medium 2-3 min. Do not microwave. Assemble plates fresh — chips stay separate to preserve crunch.

Lasts: Follow the Soules Kitchen use-by date on the family pack. Leftover cooked steak: 2-3 days fridge in a sealed container. Wholly minis: per label date. Chips + tortillas: pantry shelf life.

Make this when

You had no time to cook from scratch, delivery feels like a defeat, and you want a family dinner ready in 10 min. Keep a Soules Kitchen family pack refrigerated for the busy-day emergency. One skillet reheat, two plate builds, ~$5/plate. Cheaper than delivery, fewer regrets.

Brands I use

Soules Kitchen
Street Taco Steak with Salsa Roja (22 oz family pack, refrigerated aisle, ~190 cal / 22g protein per labeled serving)
T1 shortcut protein. Fully cooked carne-asada-style steak that reheats in 4 min on the stovetop. Included salsa roja packets = zero-effort adult sauce. Family pack = 4 labeled servings, cleanly splits 2 adults + 2 kids. The whole recipe is built around this product being available.
La Banderita
Carb Counter Street Taco Tortillas (10.8 oz pack, ~60 cal / 5g protein per 2 tortillas)
The adult-macro unlock. Regular street-taco tortillas run ~150 cal / 4g protein per 2 — Carb Counter cuts calories nearly in half AND adds a bit of protein. High-fiber, still a real flour tortilla. Skipping this kills the 420 cal / 40P target.
Mission
Regular Street Taco Flour Tortillas (~150 cal / 4g protein per 2)
Kid-carb — soft, familiar, non-diet-y flour tortilla. Kids get NORMAL bread. The macro-hack is not for them. Sub any street-taco-size flour tortilla.
Khloud
Nacho Protein Chips (~120 cal / 7g protein per serving)
Adult chip macro lever. 1/2 serving per adult = ~60 cal / ~4g protein — real chip crunch with real protein. Milk + pea protein allergens (check label). Sub Quest Tortilla-Style Protein Chips or HighKey.
Wholly Guacamole
Classic Minis (2 oz single-serve cups, ~70 cal per cup)
Kid sauce. Individually portioned, no oxidation, no cutting an avocado 5 min before dinner. 1 mini per kid keeps portions honest. Sub any store-bought guac cup or plain avocado slices.
